title: Auto-promote next queued PRD when no active PRD exists
specification:
# PRD: Auto-promote next queued PRD when no active PRD exists

Priority: high

## Problem
Queued PRDs can remain stalled when there is no active PRD and the PM agent is idle, requiring manual promotion.

## Goal
Automatically promote the next queued PRD into the active slot whenever the repo has no active PRD and at least one queued PRD is available.

## Requirements
- Detect the state where `activePrds` is empty and `queuedPrds` has at least one item.
- Automatically select the next queued PRD using the existing queue ordering.
- Promote that PRD to active without requiring a manual manager action.
- Ensure the PM/planning flow is triggered after promotion.
- Avoid promoting a second PRD if one becomes active during the same evaluation cycle.
- Surface the promotion event in the control panel status or activity log.

## Acceptance Criteria
- When `activePrds` is empty and at least one PRD is queued, the first queued PRD is promoted automatically.
- When an active PRD already exists, no queued PRD is auto-promoted.
- After promotion, the promoted PRD is no longer listed in `queuedPrds` and appears in `activePrds`.
- The PM agent reflects the new active PRD and begins normal planning behavior.
- No duplicate promotions occur during refreshes or repeated evaluations.

## Verification
- Test state transition from no active PRD plus non-empty queue to a single promoted active PRD.
- Test that the queue order is preserved when multiple PRDs are queued.
- Test that no promotion occurs when an active PRD already exists.
- Test repeated polling/refresh behavior to confirm idempotency.
- Verify the control panel shows the promotion outcome clearly.

tasks.title: Implement automatic promotion of the next queued PRD when no active PRD exists
tasks.description: Add the repo/runtime logic that evaluates PRD state, automatically promotes the next queued PRD into `activePrds` when no active PRD exists, triggers the normal PM planning flow after promotion, and exposes the promotion outcome in control-plane status or activity reporting. Likely touch points include PRD/queue state handling under `src/autonomy-v2/commands/` or `src/sync/`, runtime status/control-plane summaries under `src/autonomy-v2/control-plane/` or `src/server/control-plane/`, and focused tests covering queue promotion and idempotent polling behavior.
acceptance: When evaluation runs with `activePrds` empty and at least one queued PRD present, the first queued PRD by existing queue order is promoted automatically without any manual manager action.
After auto-promotion completes, the promoted PRD is removed from `queuedPrds`, appears in `activePrds`, and no later queued PRD is promoted in the same evaluation cycle.
When evaluation runs while an active PRD already exists, the queued PRD list remains unchanged and no auto-promotion occurs.
The promotion path triggers the same downstream PM/planning behavior expected for an active PRD so the PM agent begins normal planning on the promoted PRD.
Repeated refreshes or polling over unchanged state are idempotent: once a queued PRD has been promoted, subsequent evaluations do not duplicate the promotion or add a second active PRD.
Control-plane status, dashboard activity, or equivalent surfaced runtime output clearly reports that an automatic queued-PRD promotion occurred and identifies the promoted PRD.
